16.t: Working with data: what is in a fuel?
q: State the two elements in every hydrocarbon.
Complete the carbon percentage for octane.
Describe the trend in carbon percentage as molecules get bigger.
The carbon percentage rises (75, 80, 82, 84) as the chain gets longer.
Suggest why longer hydrocarbons are more likely to make soot when they burn.
They have more carbon compared with hydrogen, so they need more oxygen per gram; with limited air some carbon is left unburnt as soot.
